# Adesa Energy

> Adesa Energy provides mobile compressed natural gas (CNG) vehicle conversion, on-demand refueling, fleet conversion packages, maintenance, support, and training in Nigeria.

Canonical website: https://www.adesaenergy.com
Primary language: English (Nigeria)
Service area: Nigeria

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.adesaenergy.com/): Mobile CNG conversion and refueling overview.
- [Solutions](https://www.adesaenergy.com/solutions): Conversion, refueling, fleet, maintenance, and training services.
- [Savings calculator](https://www.adesaenergy.com/calculator): Estimate petrol-to-CNG fuel savings.
- [Resources and FAQs](https://www.adesaenergy.com/resources): Practical CNG guidance and common questions.
- [Blog](https://www.adesaenergy.com/blog): Adesa Energy articles about CNG adoption, conversion, and company updates.
- [About](https://www.adesaenergy.com/about): Company mission, vision, and operating approach.
- [Waitlist](https://www.adesaenergy.com/waitlist): Request a conversion, refueling service, or financing information.
